tool_args.rationale: The six observations support a smooth substrate-saturating base field modulated by sink-gradient suppression, consistent with the pilot signatures and open-branch observation. The avalanche branch remains unexcited, so exclude it and numerically fit the four identifiable smooth-law parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed gradients are at most 2.2, below the noted avalanche threshold region; the available high-gradient probe is not in the menu, and fitting an unobserved avalanche branch is unwarranted.
The open-branch probe added a sixth observation across the substrate range; fitting the smooth base-field/sink-gradient law and using fresh confirmation is a lower-cost next step.
Its u-only dependence cannot account for the substantial response variation at comparable substrate levels with different s_grad.
Its monotone separable powers do not naturally represent the indicated sink-gradient suppression.
